desc.v: Reserved
This is the status bit of LEDC_OVF_CNT_RESET_CHn.
Set this bit to reset the timer-overflow counter of channel n.
This bit is used to count the number of times when the timer selected by channel n overflows.
This register is used to configure the maximum times of overflow minus 1. The LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT interrupt will be triggered when channel n overflows for (LEDC_OVF_NUM_CHn + 1) times.

This bit is used to update the listed fields below for channel n, and will be automatically cleared by hardware: LEDC_HPOINT_CHn; LEDC_DUTY_START_CHn; LEDC_SIG_OUT_EN_CHn; LEDC_TIMER_SEL_CHn; LEDC_DUTY_NUM_CHn; LEDC_DUTY_CYCLE_CHn; LEDC_DUTY_SCALE_CHn; LEDC_DUTY_INC_CHn; LEDC_OVF_CNT_EN_CHn.
This bit is used to control the output value when channel n is inactive (when LEDC_SIG_OUT_EN_CHn is 0).
Set this bit to enable signal output on channel n.
This field is used to select one of timers for channel n. 0: select timer0; 1: select timer1; 2: select timer2; 3: select timer3.
Configures whether or not to enable duty cycle fading. 0: Disable; 1: Enable.
This register is used to increase or decrease the duty of output signal on channel n. 1: Increase; 0: Decrease.
This register is used to control the number of times the duty cycle will be changed.
The duty will change every LEDC_DUTY_CYCLE_CHn on channel n.
This register is used to configure the changing step scale of duty on channel n.
This bit is used to control clock. 1: Force clock on for register. 0: Support clock only when application writes registers.
Reserved
This field is used to select the common clock source for all the 4 timers. 1: APB_CLK; 2:
RC_FAST_CLK
XTAL_CLK
Reserved
The output value changes to high when the selected timers has reached the value specified by this register.
Reserved
This register is used to change the output duty by controlling the Lpoint. The output value turns to low when the selected timers has reached the Lpoint.
Reserved
This register stores the current duty of output signal on channel n.
Reserved
Set this bit to update LEDC_CLK_DIV_TIMERx and LEDC_TIMERx_DUTY_RES.
This bit is used to reset timer x. The counter will show 0 after reset.
This bit is used to suspend the counter in timer x.
Reserved
This register is used to configure the divisor for the divider in timer x. The least significant eight bits represent the fractional part.
This register is used to control the range of the counter in timer x.
Reserved
This register stores the current counter value of timer x.
Reserved

fields.field: LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT_RAW (n = 7 at bit 19 down to n = 0 at bit 12)

desc.v: Interrupt raw bit for channel n. Triggered when the ovf_cnt has reached the value specified by LEDC_OVF_NUM_CHn.

fields.field: LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT_RAW (n = 7 at bit 11 down to n = 0 at bit 4)

desc.v: Interrupt raw bit for channel n. Triggered when the gradual change of duty has finished.

fields.field: LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT_RAW (x = 3 at bit 3 down to x = 0 at bit 0)

desc.v: Triggered when the timer x has reached its maximum counter value.
Reserved

fields.field: LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT_ST (n = 7 at bit 19 down to n = 0 at bit 12)

desc.v: This is the masked interrupt status bit for the LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT interrupt when LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT_ENA is set to 1.

fields.field: LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT_ST (n = 7 at bit 11 down to n = 0 at bit 4)

desc.v: This is the masked interrupt status bit for the LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT interrupt when LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT_ENA is set to 1.

fields.field: LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT_ST (x = 3 at bit 3 down to x = 0 at bit 0)

desc.v: This is the masked interrupt status bit for the LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT interrupt when LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT_ENA is set to 1.
Reserved

fields.field: LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT_ENA (n = 7 at bit 19 down to n = 0 at bit 12)

desc.v: The interrupt enable bit for the LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT interrupt.

fields.field: LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT_ENA (n = 7 at bit 11 down to n = 0 at bit 4)

desc.v: The interrupt enable bit for the LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT interrupt.

fields.field: LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT_ENA (x = 3 at bit 3 down to x = 0 at bit 0)

desc.v: The interrupt enable bit for the LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT interrupt.
Reserved

fields.field: LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT_CLR (n = 7 at bit 19 down to n = 0 at bit 12)

desc.v: Set this bit to clear the LEDC_OVF_CNT_CHn_INT interrupt.

fields.field: LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT_CLR (n = 7 at bit 11 down to n = 0 at bit 4)

desc.v: Set this bit to clear the LEDC_DUTY_CHNG_END_CHn_INT interrupt.

fields.field: LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT_CLR (x = 3 at bit 3 down to x = 0 at bit 0)

desc.v: Set this bit to clear the LEDC_TIMERx_OVF_INT interrupt.
